raw_segments.text: Lucio, this is the point. The duke is very strangely gone from hence, Fifty bore many
gentlemen, myself being one, in hand, and hope of action. But we do learn by those that
know the very nerves of state, his givings out were of an infinite distance from his
true-meant design. Upon his place, fifty-five, and with full line of his authority, governs
Lord Angelo, a man whose blood is very snow-broth, one who never feels the wanton stings and
motions of the sense, but doth rebate and blunt his natural edge sixty with prophets
of the mind, study and fast. He to give fear to use and liberty, which have for long run
by the hideous law, as mice by lion's-hath picked out an act, under whose heavy sense
your brother's life sixty-five falls into forfeit. He arrests him on it, and follows
close the rigor of the statute, to make him an example. All hope is gone, unless you have
the grace by your fair prayer to soften Angelo. And that's my pith of business, Seventy,
Twixt you and your poor brother.
Lucio, this is the point.
The Duke is very strangely gone from hence, fifty bore many gentlemen, myself being one
in hand and hope of action.
But we do learn by those that know the very nerves of state, his givings out were of an
infinite distance from his true-meant design.
Upon his place, fifty-five and with full line of his authority, governs Lord Angilo, a man
who never feels the wanton stings and motions of the sense, but doth rebate and blunt his
natural edge sixty with profits of the mind, study and fast.
He to give fear to use and liberty, which have for long run by the hideous law, as mice
by lion's-hath picked out an act, under whose heavy sense your brother's life sixty-five
falls into forfeit, he arrests him on it, and follows close the rigor of the statute,
to make him an example.
All hope is gone, unless you have the grace by your fair prayer to soften Angilo.
And that's my pith of business, seventy, twixt you and your poor brother.
